name: Laisky One API MCP Proxy
description: Authenticated MCP Streamable HTTP proxy for the oneapi.laisky.com AI gateway. It exposes administrator-configured upstream MCP tools through One API relay keys.

server.description: Public MCP discovery endpoint for documentation and capability inspection.

authenticatedServer.description: Authenticated MCP relay for administrator-configured upstream tools.

notes: The available MCP tools depend on administrator-configured upstream MCP servers and relay-key permissions.
Relay keys are secrets and must not be logged, exposed in URLs, or included in prompts.
